title: 第21章 联邦荣耀第22章 重力淬体
content_zh:
“今天，是你们入伍以来的第一次大考。”
独眼缓缓开口，声音通过气血运转，如同雷霆一般在整个广场上空轰然炸响：“我还是那句老话——联邦不养闲人！更不需要废物！”
“你们这群渣滓里，注定有一大部分人，连站在前线当炮灰的资格都没有！”
他猛地一挥手臂，广场上空的光脑终端瞬间启动，投射出几幅数十米高的巨大全息画面。
第一幅画面中，是暗无天日的地下矿坑。
昏暗的探照灯下，一群形如枯槁、骨瘦如柴的劳工，正步履蹒跚地推着沉重的矿车。他们的眼神空洞得没有一丝光亮，仿佛一具具行尸走肉。
画面一转，又变成了终日弥漫着刺鼻毒气与高温胀气的重型兵工厂。
在炽热的铁水和轰鸣的机械臂下，工人们被高温炙烤得面目全非，甚至连皮肤都与防毒面具长在了一起，只能日复一日地进行着麻木的劳作。
“都给我睁大眼睛看清楚了！”
独眼的声音透着不容置疑的冷酷：“大考不合格者，发配矿星与地下锻造厂！你们将在那里当一辈子的耗材，直到你们的骨头被彻底榨干最后一滴骨髓！”
“但是——”
独眼话音一转，声音陡然拔高，“达标者，不仅能正式留在正规军，本次考核排名前列的种子，还将获得军功积分，以及军方特供的【基因强化液】！”
“二者皆为联邦出力，倒是一同享受荣耀，如何选择，便看你们自己了。”
随着他的话音落下，头顶的全息画面再次疯狂闪动。
这一次，映入所有人眼帘的，是一颗刚刚经历了惨烈焦土战役的暗红色星球。
大地上堆满了如同山岳般的虫族狰狞尸骸，墨绿色的酸血汇聚成河。
而在尸山血海的最高处，一名身穿重型动力战甲、身形足足有五米高的恐怖战士，正单手握着一杆巨大的战旗，猛地刺穿了一只高阶虫族母体的头颅！
战旗迎风招展，联邦的徽记在硝烟中熠熠生辉，宣告着这场星际血战的绝对胜利。
看着这极具视觉冲击力的一幕，在场的所有新兵皆是心头一凛，血液开始不受控制地加速流淌。
成为一名荣耀的星际战士，还是沦为地下矿坑里不见天日的劳工？

在这个人命如草芥、万族厮杀的大远征时代，能为人类联邦战死沙场，对于底层人来说，绝对已经是一种无上的恩赐！
“就在你们在这里像狗一样训练的这十天里，天狼星系联邦远征队，在前线再度收复了一颗被虫族占据的生命星球！”
独眼的独眼中迸射出狂热与凶戾的光芒：“今日，为联邦的胜利而贺！也希望你们之中，有朝一日能有人成为那画面中的一员，而不是一滩烂泥！”
“考核内容——重力室抗压测试！”
独眼厉声暴喝，宣布了生死的考题：“及格线：1.5倍标准重力下，坚持10分钟！现在，按编号，分批入场！”
轰隆隆——
随着指令下达，广场后方，一座极其庞大的半球形金属建筑缓缓震动起来。
伴随着沉重的机械咬合声，厚达数米的合金装甲门向两侧开启，露出了一口深不见底、闪烁着幽蓝色磁场光芒的重力深井。
那是足以碾碎凡人骨血的钢铁巨兽。
“第一批！编号g17-0001至1000，入列！”
第一批一千名被点到编号的新兵，面无血色地从方阵中走出。
有的人双腿都在不自觉地发抖，但在周围执法队冰冷的枪口下，只能像被赶进屠宰场的牲口一般，硬着头皮走进了重力深井。
沉重的合金大门轰然关闭。
倒计时开始跳动。
content_en:
"Today is your first big test since joining the army."
One Eye slowly spoke, and his voice circulated through his blood, and boomed like thunder over the entire square: "I still say the same old saying - the Federation does not support idlers! It does not need waste!"
"There are bound to be a large number of you scum who are not even qualified to stand on the front lines and serve as cannon fodder!"
He waved his arm suddenly, and the optical brain terminal above the square was activated instantly, projecting several huge holographic images tens of meters high.
In the first picture, there is a dark underground mine.
Under the dim searchlight, a group of haggard and skinny workers were pushing a heavy mine cart with unsteady steps. Their eyes were so empty that they looked like zombies.
As soon as the scene changed, it turned into a heavy arsenal filled with pungent poisonous gas and high-temperature flatulence all day long.
Under the hot molten iron and roaring mechanical arms, the workers were burned beyond recognition by the high temperature, and even their skin grew together with the gas masks. They could only carry out numb work day after day.
"Open your eyes and see clearly!"
The one-eyed voice was undeniably cold: "Those who fail the exam will be assigned to mining stars and underground forges! You will be used as consumables there for the rest of your life, until your bones are completely drained of the last drop of marrow!"
"But-"
The one-eyed man changed his voice and suddenly raised his voice, "Those who meet the criteria will not only be able to officially stay in the regular army, but the top seeds in this assessment will also receive military merit points and the [Gene Enhancement Fluid] specially provided by the military!"
"Both of them contribute to the Federation, but they enjoy the glory together. It's up to you how you choose."
As his words fell, the holographic picture above his head flashed crazily again.
This time, what caught everyone's eyes was a dark red planet that had just experienced a tragic scorched earth battle.
The ground was filled with mountains of ferocious Zerg corpses, and dark green acid blood gathered into a river.
And at the highest point of the blood sea of ​​​​the mountain of corpses, a terrifying warrior who was five meters tall and wearing heavy-duty power armor was holding a huge battle flag in one hand and suddenly pierced the head of a high-level Zerg mother!
The battle flag fluttered in the wind, and the emblem of the Federation shone brightly in the smoke, declaring the absolute victory of this bloody interstellar battle.
Seeing this visually stunning scene, all the recruits present felt their hearts tremble, and their blood began to flow uncontrollably.
Become a glorious space warrior, or become a laborer in an underground mine that never sees the light of day?
In this era of the Great Crusade, where human lives are at stake and all races are fighting each other, being able to die in battle for the Human Federation is definitely a supreme gift for the people at the bottom!
"In the ten days that you have been training here like dogs, the Sirius Galaxy Federation expedition team has once again regained a living planet occupied by the Zerg on the front line!"
The one-eyed eye burst out with fanatical and ferocious light: "Today, congratulations on the victory of the Federation! I also hope that some of you will one day become a member of that picture, instead of a puddle of mud!"
"Assessment content - gravity chamber pressure test!"
One Eye shouted fiercely and announced the life-and-death test: "Passing line: 10 minutes under 1.5 times standard gravity! Now, enter in batches according to numbers!"
Rumble——
As the order was given, an extremely large hemispherical metal building slowly shook behind the square.
Accompanied by the sound of heavy mechanical clenching, the several-meter-thick alloy armor door opened to both sides, revealing a bottomless gravity well that glowed with the light of a faint blue magnetic field.
It was a giant steel beast capable of crushing the bones and blood of mortals.
"The first batch! Numbers g17-0001 to 1000, listed!"
The first batch of one thousand recruits whose numbers were called walked out of the phalanx with bloodless faces.
someThe person's legs were shaking unconsciously, but under the cold muzzles of the surrounding law enforcement teams, he could only bravely walk into the deep gravity well like an animal being driven into a slaughterhouse.
The heavy alloy door slammed shut.
The countdown begins to beat.
